segments.title: An AI that messages you first
segments.say: Tool Drop number one. Claude Duet is an AI that messages you first.

segments.title: Not tested by us
segments.say: Not tested by us. This is based on Anthropic's official announcement.

segments.title: What it does
bullets: Asks before it sends or pays
segments.say: Each morning it sends a brief from your connected apps, checks in every few hours, and asks before it sends, pays, or deletes anything.

segments.title: The limits
segments.say: Anthropic says it can still misread what's urgent, it uses your normal Claude limits, and it runs in its own app.

segments.title: Who can get it
segments.say: It's starting with US Pro, Max and Ultra subscribers, by waitlist. No free plan is listed.

segments.title: COMMENT BELOW
segments.say: Comment if you want a real hands-on test, and follow Nexora, the honest referee for AI.
segments.sub: Nexora: the honest referee for AI. Follow for one a day.
